Dashboards and presentations built in Power BI for non-technical audiences, plus a SQL database project.

- [Merger Sales Dashboard](Storytelling/merger-dashboard.qmd): A dashboard that weighs the case for and against a merger.
- [Finance Dashboard](Storytelling/finance-dashboard.qmd): A Power BI final project in finance.
- [Mutual Fund Risk Portfolio](Storytelling/mutual-fund-risk.qmd): Fund recommendations across five risk levels for a retirement-focused family.
- [Survey Analysis: Religious Perceptions](Storytelling/survey-analysis.qmd): A Power BI analysis of survey data on demographic patterns in religious perceptions.
- [SQL: Music Library Database](Storytelling/music-database.qmd): A relational database with constraints, transactions, queries, and views.
